name: castreader
description: Build runnable speech features and generate playable audio with cost estimates and restartable jobs.

interface.longDescription: Build a working speech feature or generate MP3/WAV files with live cost estimates and saved-job recovery. The experimental read-answer workflow requires a verified desktop DOM adapter before synthesis; synchronized original-answer reading is not yet implemented. API trial/wallet is separate from App Pro.
defaultPrompt: Add a working text-to-speech feature to my app.
Generate an MP3 from this text and show the cost.
Check whether CastReader can read this desktop answer with synchronized original-text highlighting.
